pages.title: Fractal Set
pages.text: Iterate z goes to z squared plus c, and colour each point by whether it escapes. The boundary that results is infinitely detailed: zoom in anywhere and new spirals, filaments and tiny copies of the whole appear. Holding it, the edges seem fuzzy, and they never sharpen however closely you look.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Running a Koch crystal's self-similar rule through a function graph on the complex plane, I asked the Analytic Continuator which points stayed bounded. The answer was the Mandelbrot set, coastlines within coastlines.
